items.stem: A stakeholder asks ChatGPT to 'write the PRD'. What is the most important control before that PRD is used to plan work?

options.text: A named human owner reviews and approves the content
options.rationale: Correct: a human owner must remain accountable for AI-drafted requirements before they drive work.

options.text: The PRD is at least five pages long
options.rationale: Length is not a quality or accountability control.
Wording of the prompt does not make the output correct or approved.

options.text: The model used its newest version
options.rationale: Model version does not substitute for human review and sign-off.

items.explanation: Correct: a human owner must remain accountable for AI-drafted requirements before they drive work.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which acceptance criterion is written so a tester can objectively verify it?

options.text: Given a logged-out user, when they submit valid credentials, then they land on the dashboard within 2 seconds
options.rationale: Correct: it states precondition, action and an observable, measurable result.

options.text: The login should feel fast and friendly
options.rationale: 'Fast and friendly' is subjective and not objectively testable.

options.text: Users will like the new login
options.rationale: A preference is not a verifiable criterion.
'Works well' has no measurable condition to test against.

items.explanation: Correct: it states precondition, action and an observable, measurable result.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep an AI-drafted backlog traceable and trustworthy? (Select TWO)

options.text: Link each generated user story back to its source note or interview
options.rationale: Correct: traceability lets a reviewer confirm each story reflects real evidence.

options.text: Record which requirements a human reviewer has approved
options.rationale: Correct: an explicit approval record keeps accountability with a person, not the model.

options.text: Delete the source notes once stories are generated
options.rationale: Deleting sources destroys traceability and the ability to verify stories.

options.text: Accept the longest story list the model produces
options.rationale: Quantity is not evidence of correctness or completeness.

items.explanation: Correct: traceability lets a reviewer confirm each story reflects real evidence.
